results.name: WP-10 oracle: the same 27-request matrix (fetch + XHR; credentials include / same-origin / omit; ACAO * vs echoed; ACAC; preflights that pass, are reused from the cache (incl. `*` entries), deny a method, deny `*` with credentials, Authorization under `*`; a JSON body; a redirect; withCredentials before and after open(); cross-site Set-Cookie; Set-Cookie with omit) gives IDENTICAL results natively in Chromium and through the proxy — failures, cookies and Origin the sites saw, Sec-Fetch-Site/Mode, readable response headers

WP-10 oracle is not vacuous: the matrix exercises both outcomes — the cross-site request with credentials carries ONLY the SameSite=None cookie (b=1, not the Lax bl=1); same-origin reads the private header, cross-origin reads only exposed ones; ACAO * with credentials, a JSON body without a preflight answer and a denied method all FAIL; the cached preflight was not repeated

WP-10 adversary inside the page: an UNTAGGED raw request (the shim's own rawFetch, bypassing tagging) and a FORGED document id both reach B with Origin "null" and no cookies; a script-fetched copy of another site's page carries no document id

WP-10 adversary outside the browser: a direct client using a REAL document id cannot bypass the read check (ACAO * with credentials → 403 and no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, reason given); a failed preflight never sends the actual request

TLS identity for IP-literal sites (TT39 fix): https://127.0.0.2 with a valid certificate FOR 127.0.0.2 loads through the proxy; a certificate from the same trusted CA but for "localhost" is refused for 127.0.0.2 (before the fix Node checked IP sites against "localhost" and would have accepted it)

modal shortcut fails (D): the TT35–TT38 approach — every proxied response readable by any page via ACAO * — is exactly what a native browser refuses: in the native run, B's credentialed read under ACAO * failed and Lax cookies never went cross-site; the proxy now matches it

WP-11 oracle: Web Workers in a proxied page behave as natively — a classic worker (importScripts, relative fetch, new Request, XHR, a cross-origin fetch with the PAGE's origin, a WebSocket, a nested worker), a module worker (static import, top-level await, import.meta.url, awaiting its first message at top level, importScripts → TypeError; a module SharedWorker), a page-made blob: worker, SharedWorker (two connections share one instance; another name gets its own) and the SecurityError for a cross-origin script: results IDENTICAL natively and through the proxy
